display_long_description:
Volumetric video just made its biggest leap. Vivid 4D is here.
Forget everything you've seen in mixed reality. Vivid 4D uses 4D Gaussian Splatting — the world's most advanced volumetric rendering technology — to place real, life-sized humans inside your room with photorealistic accuracy. Real skin. Real motion. Real presence. Zero CGI.
With full 6DoF freedom, you don't watch the performance. You inhabit it. Walk around. Get close. See every detail from every angle — because this isn't a recording designed to be watched. It's a presence designed to be experienced.
Core Technology, Real Results:
4DGS Volumetric Rendering
The same breakthrough technology redefining spatial computing — now in your living room. Photorealistic humans rendered in real-time with unmatched clarity.
1:1 Scale Human Presence
Not a miniature. Not a projection. A full-scale human being, standing in your space, moving exactly as they did when captured.
True 6DoF Exploration
The performance doesn't move. You do. Every angle, every distance, every moment — on your terms.
Full Library. Free. Now.
Every premium performance is free during Early Access. This window won't stay open.
Vivid 4D. The new standard for human presence in mixed reality.
